prompts.featured: Use case: stylized-concept. Original MEE editorial artwork, a premium crafted miniature of tactile paper, limestone and ceramic. Cobalt blue, vermilion red and warm ivory palette, fine material detail, elegant directional light and controlled shadows. Wide horizontal composition, essential objects inside central safe crop. No typography, numerals, labels, logos, watermark, statistical graphic or multi-panel collage. An oblique orbital view of a stylized Korean peninsula as a continuous dark cobalt ceramic landform surrounded by deep blue sea, the southern area with many delicate warm ivory pinpoints of urban light and the northern area with very few. Subtle atmospheric rim, sober refined editorial sculpture, no border line or political symbols. Clearly a crafted conceptual miniature, not a satellite photograph or measured map. Wide 1200x630 cover.
